services.desc: Enjoy a 3-course dinner at the world-famous Volanti restaurant and an approximately 15-minute sunset helicopter flight for 2, departing and arriving at Volanti. Watch our video to get the whole scoop today! Enjoy a fabulous brunch at the world-famous Volanti restaurant and a scenic 15-minute helicopter flight for 2, departing and arriving at Volanti. Saturday & Sunday only. Fly over north Phoenix and off to Squaw Peak, then to the famous Camelback Mountain to see Paradise Valley’s most impressive homes and lush green golf courses. Duration: 18-20 minutes With this tour, you receive all of the benefits of the entire Paradise Valley tour, but that is just the beginning of your adventure.

blurb: Guests take helicopter tours over Scottsdale, Paradise Valley, Fountain Hills, and surrounding desert landscapes. Options include scenic flights, wedding proposals, and combined jeep and helicopter excursions. Flights offer aerial views of landmarks, lakes, and mountains with durations from 15 minutes to over 3 hours.
extraNote: Proposal flights are non-refundable; photo option requires 50% deposit to photographer · Rescheduling may be possible subject to fee · Flight takes place rain or shine; helicopters can fly around rain cells · Heliport at 7430 E Butherus Dr Suite G, Scottsdale, AZ 85260
